verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, and both have the same faults. 'Should You' has been pulled away from the title block and sits on the busy hand and sleeve area, which makes it hard to read and puts the reading order out of sequence. The '=' marks and dashed rules float apart from the text they belong to. The yellow ribbon is out of line with 'a Workout?' and runs into the bottom edge of the canvas. Neither one is ready to ship.
